paraphrase: Added premise, not attributed to Aristotle: if the natural motion of a thing not moved by itself (as of the light and the heavy) has a per accidens mover, such as the remover of a hindrance, it also has a per se mover in that respect. Physics VIII.4, 255b35-256a2 gives only the disjunction 'by the generator or by the remover' and does not say that the generator still moves a light body while it rises.
